canonical_project: Bundelkhand Data Centre/AI Hub (region-level plan incl. Jhansi)
notes: CM Yogi Adityanath pitched Bundelkhand (Jhansi is the gateway city of the UP Bundelkhand region) as a data centre/AI hub targeting ~Rs 2 lakh crore investment; UP Data Centre Policy 2026 (unveiled 6 Jul 2026) offers extra incentives for Bundelkhand and Purvanchal. Regional announcement only - no specific project in Jhansi district named yet.
